WITH batsman_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        m.season_id,
        b.striker,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    JOIN match m ON b.match_id = m.match_id
    GROUP BY m.season_id, b.striker
),
bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT 
        m.season_id,
        bb.bowler,
        COUNT(*) as total_wickets
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN match m ON w.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON w.match_id = bb.match_id AND w.over_id = bb.over_id AND w.ball_id = bb.ball_id
    WHERE w.kind_out NOT IN ('run out', 'hit wicket', 'retired hurt')
    GROUP BY m.season_id, bb.bowler
),
ranked_batsmen AS (
    SELECT 
        season_id,
        striker,
        total_runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC, striker ASC) as rn
    FROM batsman_runs
),
ranked_bowlers AS (
    SELECT 
        season_id,
        bowler,
        total_wickets,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season_id ORDER BY total_wickets DESC, bowler ASC) as rn
    FROM bowler_wickets
)
SELECT 
    rb.season_id,
    rb.striker as batsman_id,
    rb.total_runs,
    rbw.bowler as bowler_id,
    rbw.total_wickets
FROM ranked_batsmen rb
JOIN ranked_bowlers rbw ON rb.season_id = rbw.season_id AND rb.rn = rbw.rn
WHERE rb.rn <= 3
ORDER BY rb.season_id, rb.rn

),
extras_runs AS (
    SELECT m.season_id, bb.non_striker as player_id, SUM(er.extra_runs) as extra_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN match m ON bb.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN extra_runs er ON bb.match_id = er.match_id AND bb.over_id = er.over_id AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY m.season_id, bb.non_striker
),
combined_runs AS (
    SELECT season_id, player_id, COALESCE(runs, 0) as runs
    FROM batsman_runs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT season_id, player_id, COALESCE(extra_runs, 0) as runs
    FROM extras_runs
),
total_runs AS (
    SELECT season_id, player_id, SUM(runs) as total_runs
    FROM combined_runs
    GROUP BY season_id, player_id
),
batsmen_ranked AS (
    SELECT season_id, player_id, total_runs as runs,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC, player_id ASC) as rn
    FROM total_runs
),
bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT m.season_id, bb.bowler as player_id, COUNT(*) as wickets
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON wt.match_id = bb.match_id AND wt.over_id = bb.over_id AND wt.ball_id = bb.ball_id
    JOIN match m ON bb.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE wt.kind_out NOT IN ('run out', 'hit wicket', 'retired hurt')
    GROUP BY m.season_id, bb.bowler
),
bowlers_ranked AS (
    SELECT season_id, player_id, wickets,

    FROM bowler_wickets
),
matched_results AS (
    SELECT br.season_id, br.player_id as batsman_id, br.runs,

WITH batsman_runs AS (
    SELECT bb.striker as player_id, m.season_id, SUM(bbs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bbs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON bbs.match_id = bb.match_id 
      AND bbs.over_id = bb.over_id 
      AND bbs.ball_id = bb.ball_id 
      AND bbs.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    JOIN match m ON bb.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.striker, m.season_id
),
batsman_ranked AS (
    SELECT player_id, season_id, total_runs,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC, player_id ASC) as rank
    FROM batsman_runs
),
bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler as player_id, m.season_id, COUNT(*) as total_wickets
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON wt.match_id = bb.match_id 
      AND wt.over_id = bb.over_id 
      AND wt.ball_id = bb.ball_id 
      AND wt.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    JOIN match m ON bb.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
      AND wt.kind_out NOT IN ('run out', 'hit wicket', 'retired hurt')
    GROUP BY bb.bowler, m.season_id
),
bowler_ranked AS (
    SELECT player_id, season_id, total_wickets,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season_id ORDER BY total_wickets DESC, player_id ASC) as rank
    FROM bowler_wickets
),
batsman_top3 AS (
    SELECT player_id, season_id, total_runs, rank
    FROM batsman_ranked
    WHERE rank <= 3
),
bowler_top3 AS (
    SELECT player_id, season_id, total_wickets, rank
    FROM bowler_ranked
    WHERE rank <= 3
),
combined AS (
    SELECT bt3.season_id, bt3.rank, bt3.player_id, bt3.total_runs as runs, 'Batsman' as role, 0 as sort_order
    FROM batsman_top3 bt3
    UNION ALL
    SELECT bt3.season_id, bt3.rank, bt3.player_id, bt3.total_wickets as runs, 'Bowler' as role, 1 as sort_order
    FROM bowler_top3 bt3
)
SELECT 
    season_id,
    rank,
    player_id,
    runs,
    role
FROM combined
ORDER BY season_id, rank, sort_order

WITH batsman_runs AS (
    SELECT m.season_id, bb.striker, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    JOIN match m ON bb.match_id = m.match_id
    GROUP BY m.season_id, bb.striker
),
top_batsmen AS (
    SELECT season_id, striker, total_runs,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC, striker ASC) as rn
    FROM batsman_runs
),
bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT m.season_id, bb.bowler, COUNT(*) as total_wickets
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN wicket_taken wt ON bb.match_id = wt.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = wt.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = wt.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = wt.innings_no
    JOIN match m ON bb.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE wt.kind_out NOT IN ('run out', 'hit wicket', 'retired hurt')
    GROUP BY m.season_id, bb.bowler
),
top_bowlers AS (
    SELECT season_id, bowler, total_wickets,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season_id ORDER BY total_wickets DESC, bowler ASC) as rn
    FROM bowler_wickets
),
matched_pairs AS (
    SELECT tb.season_id, tb.striker as batsman_id, tb.total_runs,
           tb2.bowler, tb2.total_wickets, tb.rn as position
    FROM top_batsmen tb

)

FROM matched_pairs
ORDER BY season_id, position

The output should include the IDs of two players, each with their individual scores and the total partnership score. For each pair, the player with the higher individual score should be listed as player 1, and the player with the lower score as player 2. candidates.sql:
WITH ball_data AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.match_id,
        bb.innings_no,
        bb.over_id,
        bb.ball_id,
        bb.striker,
        bb.non_striker,
        COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) as runs_scored
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
),
-- Get cumulative score for each player
player_cumulative AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        innings_no,
        ball_id,
        player_id,
        runs_scored,
        SUM(runs_scored) OVER (
            PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no 
            ORDER BY ball_id 
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) as cumulative_sum
    FROM (
        SELECT match_id, innings_no, ball_id, striker as player_id, runs_scored FROM ball_data
        UNION ALL
        SELECT match_id, innings_no, ball_id, non_striker as player_id, runs_scored FROM ball_data
    )
)
SELECT 
    wt.match_id,
    wt.innings_no,
    wt.ball_id,
    wt.player_out as player_out_id,
    (SELECT MAX(pc2.cumulative_sum) FROM player_cumulative pc2 
     WHERE pc2.match_id = wt.match_id 
       AND pc2.innings_no = wt.innings_no 
       AND pc2.ball_id = wt.ball_id
       AND pc2.player_id = wt.player_out
    ) as player_out_cum_score,
    (SELECT MAX(pc3.cumulative_sum) FROM player_cumulative pc3 
     WHERE pc3.match_id = wt.match_id 
       AND pc3.innings_no = wt.innings_no 
       AND pc3.ball_id = wt.ball_id
       AND pc3.player_id <> wt.player_out
    ) as partner_cum_score
FROM wicket_taken wt
WHERE wt.match_id = 335987 AND wt.innings_no = 1
ORDER BY wt.ball_id, wt.player_out

candidates.sql:
WITH partnership AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.match_id,
        LEAST(bb.striker, bb.non_striker) as player1,
        GREATEST(bb.striker, bb.non_striker) as player2,
        SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) as partnership_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
        ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er 
        ON bb.match_id = er.match_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = er.innings_no 
        AND bb.over_id = er.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id
    GROUP BY bb.match_id, LEAST(bb.striker, bb.non_striker), GREATEST(bb.striker, bb.non_striker)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        player1,
        player2,
        partnership_runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY partnership_runs DESC) as rn
    FROM partnership
)
SELECT match_id, player1, player2, partnership_runs
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY match_id
LIMIT 10

WITH partnerships AS (
    SELECT bb.match_id, bb.innings_no, bb.striker, bb.non_striker, 
           SUM(b.runs_scored) as partnership_runs
    FROM batsman_scored b 
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON b.match_id = bb.match_id AND b.over_id = bb.over_id AND b.ball_id = bb.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bb.innings_no 
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL AND bb.non_striker IS NOT NULL 
    GROUP BY bb.match_id, bb.innings_no, bb.striker, bb.non_striker
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT match_id, striker, non_striker, partnership_runs,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY partnership_runs DESC) as rn
    FROM partnerships
),
top_partnerships AS (
    SELECT match_id, striker, non_striker, partnership_runs
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
player_scores AS (
    SELECT bb.match_id, bb.striker as player_id, SUM(b.runs_scored) as total_score
    FROM batsman_scored b
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON b.match_id = bb.match_id AND b.over_id = bb.over_id AND b.ball_id = bb.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.match_id, bb.striker
),
ordered_pairs AS (
    SELECT tp.match_id,
           CASE 
               WHEN ps.total_score > ps2.total_score THEN tp.striker
               WHEN ps.total_score < ps2.total_score THEN tp.non_striker
               WHEN tp.striker > tp.non_striker THEN tp.striker
               ELSE tp.non_striker
           END as player1,
           CASE 
               WHEN ps.total_score > ps2.total_score THEN tp.non_striker
               WHEN ps.total_score < ps2.total_score THEN tp.striker
               WHEN tp.striker > tp.non_striker THEN tp.non_striker
               ELSE tp.striker
           END as player2,
           CASE 
               WHEN ps.total_score > ps2.total_score THEN ps.total_score
               WHEN ps.total_score < ps2.total_score THEN ps2.total_score
               WHEN tp.striker > tp.non_striker THEN ps.total_score
               ELSE ps2.total_score
           END as player1_score,
           CASE 
               WHEN ps.total_score > ps2.total_score THEN ps2.total_score
               WHEN ps.total_score < ps2.total_score THEN ps.total_score
               WHEN tp.striker > tp.non_striker THEN ps2.total_score
               ELSE ps.total_score
           END as player2_score,
           tp.partnership_runs
    FROM top_partnerships tp
    LEFT JOIN player_scores ps ON tp.match_id = ps.match_id AND tp.striker = ps.player_id
    LEFT JOIN player_scores ps2 ON tp.match_id = ps2.match_id AND tp.non_striker = ps2.player_id
    WHERE tp.striker = ps.player_id AND tp.non_striker = ps2.player_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_matches
FROM ordered_pairs

WITH wicket_data AS (
    SELECT w.match_id, w.innings_no, w.ball_id, w.player_out,
           MAX(bb.non_striker) as non_striker_at_wicket
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON w.match_id = bb.match_id AND w.innings_no = bb.innings_no AND w.ball_id = bb.ball_id
    GROUP BY w.match_id, w.innings_no, w.ball_id, w.player_out
),
wicket_with_runs AS (
    SELECT wd.*,
           COALESCE(SUM(b.runs_scored), 0) as runs_until_wicket
    FROM wicket_data wd
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored b ON wd.match_id = b.match_id AND wd.innings_no = b.innings_no 
        AND b.ball_id <= wd.ball_id
    GROUP BY wd.match_id, wd.innings_no, wd.ball_id, wd.player_out, wd.non_striker_at_wicket
),
wicket_ordered AS (
    SELECT wwr.*,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wwr.match_id, wwr.innings_no ORDER BY wwr.ball_id, wwr.player_out) as wicket_seq
    FROM wicket_with_runs wwr
),
wicket_with_prev AS (
    SELECT wo.*,
           MAX(wo2.runs_until_wicket) as runs_before_partnership
    FROM wicket_ordered wo
    LEFT JOIN wicket_ordered wo2 ON wo.match_id = wo2.match_id AND wo.innings_no = wo2.innings_no 
        AND wo2.wicket_seq < wo.wicket_seq
    GROUP BY wo.match_id, wo.innings_no, wo.ball_id, wo.player_out, wo.non_striker_at_wicket, wo.runs_until_wicket, wo.wicket_seq
)
SELECT match_id, innings_no, ball_id, player_out, non_striker_at_wicket, runs_until_wicket, runs_before_partnership,
       runs_until_wicket - COALESCE(runs_before_partnership, 0) as partnership_runs
FROM wicket_with_prev WHERE match_id = 335987 ORDER BY innings_no, wicket_seq, player_out LIMIT 20

local258.question: Calculate the total number of wickets taken by each bowler (excluding run-outs and other dismissals not attributed to the bowler), their economy rate (total runs conceded divided by total overs bowled, considering only runs scored off the bat and ignoring any extra runs like wides and no-balls), their strike rate (average number of balls bowled per wicket taken), and their best bowling performance in a single match (the match with the most wickets taken by the bowler, formatted as "wickets-runs" where runs are the runs conceded excluding extras).
local258.doc:
# Special Words Definition

## Batting Average
- Batting average is a measure of a batsman's performance, calculated by dividing the total number of runs scored by the number of times they have been dismissed. A higher batting average indicates a more consistent and successful batsman.
- Batting Average = Total Runs ÷ Total Dismissals

## Strike Rate
- In batting, strike rate indicates the scoring rate of a batsman, showing the average number of runs scored per 100 balls faced. A higher strike rate reflects an aggressive and fast-scoring batsman.
- Strike Rate = (Total Runs ÷ Balls Faced) × 100

## Wickets Taken
- Wickets taken refers to the total number of times a bowler has successfully dismissed an opposing batsman. This statistic is a core measure of a bowler's effectiveness and impact on the game.

## Economy Rate
- Economy rate measures a bowler's efficiency by indicating the average number of runs conceded per over (6 balls) bowled. A lower economy rate shows greater control and efficiency in restricting the opposition's scoring.
- Economy Rate = (Total Runs Conceded ÷ Balls Bowled) × 6

## Wickets Taken
- The number of times a bowler successfully dismisses a batsman in a single match.  This metric is a direct indicator of the bowler's effectiveness, showing how many players they were able to remove from play.

## Runs Given
- The total number of runs scored by the batting side off a particular bowler’s deliveries in a single match.  This value reflects the runs the bowler has conceded to the batting team, and a lower runs-given value is typically favorable for the bowler's performance.

WITH bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler,
        wt.match_id,
        COUNT(*) as wickets_in_match
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON wt.match_id = bb.match_id AND wt.over_id = bb.over_id AND wt.ball_id = bb.ball_id
    WHERE wt.kind_out != 'run out'
    GROUP BY bb.bowler, wt.match_id
),
bowler_best_match AS (
    SELECT 
        bowler,
        match_id,
        wickets_in_match,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY wickets_in_match DESC) as rn
    FROM bowler_wickets
),
bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler,
        bb.match_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bb.match_id = er.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = er.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = er.innings_no
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler, bb.match_id
),
bowler_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler,
        COUNT(*) as total_balls_bowled,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored) - SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as total_runs_off_bat
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bb.match_id = er.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = er.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = er.innings_no
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
total_wickets AS (
    SELECT 
        bowler,
        SUM(wickets_in_match) as total_wickets
    FROM bowler_wickets
    GROUP BY bowler
)
SELECT 
    tw.bowler,
    tw.total_wickets,
    ROUND(1.0 * bs.total_runs_off_bat / bs.total_balls_bowled * 6, 2) as economy_rate,
    ROUND(1.0 * bs.total_balls_bowled / tw.total_wickets, 2) as strike_rate,
    bbm.wickets_in_match || '-' || CAST(br.runs_conceded AS VARCHAR) as best_performance
FROM total_wickets tw
JOIN bowler_stats bs ON tw.bowler = bs.bowler
JOIN bowler_best_match bbm ON tw.bowler = bbm.bowler AND bbm.rn = 1
JOIN bowler_runs br ON bbm.bowler = br.bowler AND bbm.match_id = br.match_id
ORDER BY tw.total_wickets DESC

combined_stats AS (

WITH bowler_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bowler,
        COUNT(*) as balls_bowled
    FROM ball_by_ball b

wickets AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bowler,
        COUNT(*) as wickets_taken
    FROM wicket_taken w

        AND w.over_id = b.over_id 
        AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id
        AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL AND w.kind_out != 'run out'
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
runs_conceded AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bowler,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) as runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bowler,
        w.match_id,
        COUNT(*) as match_wickets
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON w.match_id = b.match_id 
        AND w.over_id = b.over_id 
        AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id
        AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL AND w.kind_out != 'run out'
    GROUP BY b.bowler, w.match_id
),
bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bowler,
        b.match_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) as match_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.bowler, b.match_id
),
best_matches AS (
    SELECT 
        bw.bowler,
        bw.match_id,
        bw.match_wickets,
        br.match_runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bw.bowler ORDER BY bw.match_wickets DESC, br.match_runs ASC) as rn
    FROM bowler_wickets bw
    JOIN bowler_runs br ON bw.bowler = br.bowler AND bw.match_id = br.match_id
),
best_match AS (
    SELECT bowler, match_wickets, match_runs
    FROM best_matches
    WHERE rn = 1
)

FROM bowler_stats bs
LEFT JOIN wickets w ON bs.bowler = w.bowler
LEFT JOIN runs_conceded rc ON bs.bowler = rc.bowler
LEFT JOIN best_match ON bs.bowler = best_match.bowler

local259.doc:
# Special Words Definition

## Batting Average
- Batting average is a measure of a batsman's performance, calculated by dividing the total number of runs scored by the number of times they have been dismissed. A higher batting average indicates a more consistent and successful batsman.
- Batting Average = Total Runs ÷ Total Dismissals

## Strike Rate
- In batting, strike rate indicates the scoring rate of a batsman, showing the average number of runs scored per 100 balls faced. A higher strike rate reflects an aggressive and fast-scoring batsman.
- Strike Rate = (Total Runs ÷ Balls Faced) × 100

## Wickets Taken
- Wickets taken refers to the total number of times a bowler has successfully dismissed an opposing batsman. This statistic is a core measure of a bowler's effectiveness and impact on the game.

## Economy Rate
- Economy rate measures a bowler's efficiency by indicating the average number of runs conceded per over (6 balls) bowled. A lower economy rate shows greater control and efficiency in restricting the opposition's scoring.
- Economy Rate = (Total Runs Conceded ÷ Balls Bowled) × 6

## Wickets Taken
- The number of times a bowler successfully dismisses a batsman in a single match.  This metric is a direct indicator of the bowler's effectiveness, showing how many players they were able to remove from play.

## Runs Given
- The total number of runs scored by the batting side off a particular bowler’s deliveries in a single match.  This value reflects the runs the bowler has conceded to the batting team, and a lower runs-given value is typically favorable for the bowler's performance.

WITH 
-- Total runs scored per player
runs_per_player AS (
    SELECT bb.striker as player_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.striker
),

-- Balls faced per player
balls_faced_per_player AS (
    SELECT striker as player_id, COUNT(*) as balls_faced
    FROM ball_by_ball
    WHERE striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY striker
),

-- Dismissals per player
dismissals_per_player AS (
    SELECT player_out as player_id, COUNT(*) as total_dismissals
    FROM wicket_taken
    WHERE player_out IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY player_out
),

-- Wickets taken per player
wickets_per_player AS (
    SELECT player_out as player_id, COUNT(*) as total_wickets
    FROM wicket_taken
    WHERE player_out IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY player_out
),

-- Runs conceded per bowler (from balls bowled)
runs_conceded_balls AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler as player_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as balls_runs, COUNT(*) as balls_bowled
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),

-- Extras conceded per bowler
extras_conceded AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler as player_id, SUM(er.extra_runs) as extras_runs, COUNT(*) as extra_balls
    FROM extra_runs er
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON er.match_id = bb.match_id AND er.over_id = bb.over_id AND er.ball_id = bb.ball_id AND er.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    WHERE er.extra_runs IS NOT NULL AND bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),

-- Total runs conceded per bowler (balls + extras)
total_conceded AS (
    SELECT rc.player_id, rc.balls_runs + COALESCE(ec.extras_runs, 0) as total_runs_conceded, rc.balls_bowled
    FROM runs_conceded_balls rc
    LEFT JOIN extras_conceded ec ON rc.player_id = ec.player_id
),

-- Economy rate per bowler (keep balls_bowled too)
economy_per_player AS (
    SELECT player_id, total_runs_conceded, balls_bowled, (total_runs_conceded * 6.0) / balls_bowled as economy_rate
    FROM total_conceded
),

-- Most frequent role per player
role_counts AS (
    SELECT player_id, role, COUNT(*) as role_count
    FROM player_match
    GROUP BY player_id, role
),
most_frequent_role AS (
    SELECT player_id, role as most_frequent_role
    FROM (
        SELECT player_id, role, role_count,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY role_count DESC) as rn
        FROM role_counts
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),

-- Highest score per player
highest_scores AS (
    SELECT bb.striker as player_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_in_match, bb.match_id
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.striker, bb.match_id
),
highest_score_per_player AS (
    SELECT player_id, MAX(runs_in_match) as highest_score
    FROM highest_scores
    GROUP BY player_id
),

-- Runs per match for 30/50/100 counting
runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT bb.striker as player_id, bb.match_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_in_match
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.striker, bb.match_id
),
match_counts_30_50_100 AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN runs_in_match >= 30 THEN 1 END) as matches_30plus,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN runs_in_match >= 50 THEN 1 END) as matches_50plus,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN runs_in_match >= 100 THEN 1 END) as matches_100plus
    FROM runs_per_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),

-- Best bowling performance per player (most wickets in a match, tie-break by fewest runs)
bowler_match_perf AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler as player_id, bb.match_id,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN wt.player_out IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as wickets,
           SUM(bs.runs_scored) as balls_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt ON bb.match_id = wt.match_id AND bb.over_id = wt.over_id AND bb.ball_id = wt.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = wt.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler, bb.match_id
),
extras_per_match AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler as player_id, bb.match_id, SUM(er.extra_runs) as extras_runs
    FROM extra_runs er
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON er.match_id = bb.match_id AND er.over_id = bb.over_id AND er.ball_id = bb.ball_id AND er.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    WHERE er.extra_runs IS NOT NULL AND bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler, bb.match_id
),
best_bowling AS (
    SELECT bmp.player_id, 
           bmp.wickets, 
           bmp.balls_runs + COALESCE(epm.extras_runs, 0) as runs_conceded,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bmp.player_id ORDER BY bmp.wickets DESC, (bmp.balls_runs + COALESCE(epm.extras_runs, 0)) ASC) as rn
    FROM bowler_match_perf bmp
    LEFT JOIN extras_per_match epm ON bmp.player_id = epm.player_id AND bmp.match_id = epm.match_id
)
SELECT 
    p.player_id,
    p.player_name,
    mfr.most_frequent_role,
    p.batting_hand,
    p.bowling_skill,
    COALESCE(rpp.total_runs, 0) as total_runs_scored,
    COALESCE(dp.total_dismissals, 0) as total_dismissals,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(dp.total_dismissals, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(rpp.total_runs, 0) * 1.0 / dp.total_dismissals ELSE 0 END as batting_average,
    COALESCE(hsp.highest_score, 0) as highest_score,
    COALESCE(mcc.matches_30plus, 0) as matches_30plus,
    COALESCE(mcc.matches_50plus, 0) as matches_50plus,
    COALESCE(mcc.matches_100plus, 0) as matches_100plus,
    COALESCE(bfp.balls_faced, 0) as total_balls_faced,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(bfp.balls_faced, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(rpp.total_runs, 0) * 100.0 / bfp.balls_faced ELSE 0 END as strike_rate,
    COALESCE(wp.total_wickets, 0) as total_wickets_taken,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(cep.balls_bowled, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(cep.total_runs_conceded, 0) * 6.0 / cep.balls_bowled ELSE 0 END as economy_rate,
    bbp.wickets || '-' || bbp.runs_conceded as best_bowling_performance
FROM player p
LEFT JOIN most_frequent_role mfr ON p.player_id = mfr.player_id
LEFT JOIN runs_per_player rpp ON p.player_id = rpp.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismissals_per_player dp ON p.player_id = dp.player_id
LEFT JOIN highest_score_per_player hsp ON p.player_id = hsp.player_id
LEFT JOIN match_counts_30_50_100 mcc ON p.player_id = mcc.player_id
LEFT JOIN balls_faced_per_player bfp ON p.player_id = bfp.player_id
LEFT JOIN wickets_per_player wp ON p.player_id = wp.player_id
LEFT JOIN economy_per_player cep ON p.player_id = cep.player_id
LEFT JOIN best_bowling bbp ON p.player_id = bbp.player_id AND bbp.rn = 1
ORDER BY p.player_id

candidates.sql:
WITH 
players AS (
    SELECT player_id, player_name, batting_hand, bowling_skill
    FROM player
),

most_frequent_role AS (
    SELECT player_id, role as most_frequent_role
    FROM (
        SELECT player_id, role, COUNT(*) as cnt,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, role) as rn
        FROM player_match
        GROUP BY player_id, role
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),

total_runs AS (
    SELECT bb.striker as player_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.striker
),

total_matches AS (
    SELECT player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) as matches_played
    FROM player_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),

total_dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out as player_id, COUNT(*) as dismissals
    FROM wicket_taken
    GROUP BY player_out
),

highest_score AS (
    SELECT bb.striker as player_id, MAX(bs.runs_scored) as max_score
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.striker
),

matches_30 AS (
    SELECT bb.striker as player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bb.match_id) as cnt_30
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL AND bs.runs_scored >= 30
    GROUP BY bb.striker
),

matches_50 AS (
    SELECT bb.striker as player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bb.match_id) as cnt_50
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL AND bs.runs_scored >= 50
    GROUP BY bb.striker
),

matches_100 AS (
    SELECT bb.striker as player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bb.match_id) as cnt_100
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL AND bs.runs_scored >= 100
    GROUP BY bb.striker
),

balls_faced AS (
    SELECT striker as player_id, COUNT(*) as balls_faced
    FROM ball_by_ball
    WHERE striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY striker
),

total_wickets AS (
    SELECT bowler as player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) as wickets
    FROM ball_by_ball
    WHERE bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bowler
),

bowling_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler as player_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_conceded,
        COUNT(*) as balls_bowled
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),

total_balls_bowled AS (
    SELECT bowler as player_id, COUNT(*) as balls_bowled
    FROM ball_by_ball
    WHERE bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bowler
),

bowling_per_match AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler as player_id,
        bb.match_id,
        COUNT(*) as wickets,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs_given
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler, bb.match_id
),

best_bowling_per_player AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        wickets as best_wickets,
        total_runs_given as best_runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY wickets DESC, total_runs_given ASC) as rn
    FROM bowling_per_match
)

SELECT 
    p.player_id,
    p.player_name,
    mfr.most_frequent_role,
    p.batting_hand,
    p.bowling_skill,
    COALESCE(tr.runs, 0) as total_runs_scored,
    COALESCE(tm.matches_played, 0) as total_matches_played,
    COALESCE(td.dismissals, 0) as total_times_dismissed,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(td.dismissals, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(tr.runs, 0) * 1.0 / td.dismissals ELSE 0 END as batting_average,
    COALESCE(hs.max_score, 0) as highest_score,
    COALESCE(m30.cnt_30, 0) as matches_30_runs,
    COALESCE(m50.cnt_50, 0) as matches_50_runs,
    COALESCE(m100.cnt_100, 0) as matches_100_runs,
    COALESCE(bf.balls_faced, 0) as total_balls_faced,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(bf.balls_faced, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(tr.runs, 0) * 1.0 / bf.balls_faced * 100 ELSE 0 END as strike_rate,
    COALESCE(tw.wickets, 0) as total_wickets_taken,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(tbb.balls_bowled, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(bs.runs_conceded, 0) * 1.0 / tbb.balls_bowled * 6 ELSE 0 END as economy_rate,
    bbpm.best_wickets || '-' || bbpm.best_runs as best_bowling_performance
FROM players p
LEFT JOIN most_frequent_role mfr ON p.player_id = mfr.player_id
LEFT JOIN total_runs tr ON p.player_id = tr.player_id
LEFT JOIN total_matches tm ON p.player_id = tm.player_id
LEFT JOIN total_dismissals td ON p.player_id = td.player_id
LEFT JOIN highest_score hs ON p.player_id = hs.player_id
LEFT JOIN matches_30 m30 ON p.player_id = m30.player_id
LEFT JOIN matches_50 m50 ON p.player_id = m50.player_id
LEFT JOIN matches_100 m100 ON p.player_id = m100.player_id
LEFT JOIN balls_faced bf ON p.player_id = bf.player_id
LEFT JOIN total_wickets tw ON p.player_id = tw.player_id
LEFT JOIN bowling_stats bs ON p.player_id = bs.player_id
LEFT JOIN total_balls_bowled tbb ON p.player_id = tbb.player_id
LEFT JOIN best_bowling_per_player bbpm ON p.player_id = bbpm.player_id AND bbpm.rn = 1

WITH all_months AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT substr(txn_date, 1, 7) as month
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_date LIKE '2020-%' AND txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
),
customer_ids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_date LIKE '2020-%' AND txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
),
all_customer_months AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, m.month
    FROM customer_ids c
    CROSS JOIN all_months m
),
monthly_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        substr(txn_date, 1, 7) as month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) as total_deposits,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) as total_withdrawals
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_date LIKE '2020-%' AND txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
    GROUP BY customer_id, substr(txn_date, 1, 7)
),
customer_month_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        cmb.customer_id,
        cmb.month,
        COALESCE(mb.total_deposits - mb.total_withdrawals, 0) as month_end_balance
    FROM all_customer_months cmb
    LEFT JOIN monthly_balances mb ON cmb.customer_id = mb.customer_id AND cmb.month = mb.month
),
positive_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        COUNT(*) as positive_customer_count
    FROM customer_month_balances
    WHERE month_end_balance > 0
    GROUP BY month
),
highest_month AS (
    SELECT month
    FROM positive_counts
    ORDER BY positive_customer_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
lowest_month AS (
    SELECT month
    FROM positive_counts
    ORDER BY positive_customer_count ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
avg_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        AVG(month_end_balance) as avg_balance
    FROM customer_month_balances
    WHERE month IN (SELECT month FROM highest_month UNION SELECT month FROM lowest_month)
    GROUP BY month
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT month FROM highest_month) as highest_month,
    (SELECT positive_customer_count FROM positive_counts WHERE month = (SELECT month FROM highest_month)) as highest_count,
    (SELECT month FROM lowest_month) as lowest_month,
    (SELECT positive_customer_count FROM positive_counts WHERE month = (SELECT month FROM lowest_month)) as lowest_count,
    (SELECT avg_balance FROM avg_balances WHERE month = (SELECT month FROM highest_month)) as highest_avg,
    (SELECT avg_balance FROM avg_balances WHERE month = (SELECT month FROM lowest_month)) as lowest_avg,
    (SELECT avg_balance FROM avg_balances WHERE month = (SELECT month FROM highest_month)) - (SELECT avg_balance FROM avg_balances WHERE month = (SELECT month FROM lowest_month)) as difference

        AND m.month = mt.month
)
SELECT 
    customer_id,
    month,
    monthly_change,
    SUM(monthly_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) as cumulative_balance
FROM customer_month_balance

WITH running_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        CAST(txn_date AS DATE) as txn_date_date,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
            ELSE -txn_amount
        END) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as balance_at_txn
    FROM customer_transactions
),
last_txn_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) as month,
        txn_date as last_txn
    FROM customer_transactions c1
    WHERE txn_date = (
        SELECT MAX(txn_date) 
        FROM customer_transactions c2 
        WHERE c2.customer_id = c1.customer_id 
        AND strftime('%Y-%m', CAST(c2.txn_date AS DATE)) = strftime('%Y-%m', CAST(c1.txn_date AS DATE))
    )
),
closing_balances AS (
    SELECT lt.customer_id, lt.month, rb.balance_at_txn as closing_balance
    FROM last_txn_dates lt
    JOIN running_balances rb ON lt.customer_id = rb.customer_id AND lt.last_txn = rb.txn_date
),
all_months AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT strftime('%Y-%m', CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) as month
    FROM customer_transactions
),
all_combinations AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, m.month
    FROM customer_transactions c
    CROSS JOIN all_months m
)
SELECT ac.customer_id, ac.month, cb.closing_balance
FROM all_combinations ac
LEFT JOIN closing_balances cb ON ac.customer_id = cb.customer_id AND ac.month = cb.month
WHERE ac.customer_id = 1
ORDER BY ac.month

WITH all_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
all_months AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 7) as month_year FROM customer_transactions
),
all_combinations AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, m.month_year
    FROM all_customers c
    CROSS JOIN all_months m
),
monthly_transactions_with_running_balance AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date, txn_type, txn_amount, 
           SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 7) as month_year,
           SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
                    WHEN txn_type IN ('withdrawal', 'purchase') THEN -txn_amount 
                    ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date) as running_balance
    FROM customer_transactions
),
monthly_last_transaction_date AS (
    SELECT customer_id, month_year, MAX(txn_date) as last_txn_date
    FROM monthly_transactions_with_running_balance
    GROUP BY customer_id, month_year
),
monthly_last_transaction AS (
    SELECT mlt.customer_id, mlt.month_year, mlt.last_txn_date, mtrb.running_balance as closing_balance
    FROM monthly_last_transaction_date mlt
    JOIN monthly_transactions_with_running_balance mtrb 
        ON mlt.customer_id = mtrb.customer_id 
        AND mlt.month_year = mtrb.month_year 
        AND mlt.last_txn_date = mtrb.txn_date
),
monthly_closing AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, month_year, 
           closing_balance
    FROM monthly_last_transaction
),
with_closing_balance AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, c.month_year, 
           COALESCE(mc.closing_balance, LAG(mc.closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY c.customer_id ORDER BY c.month_year)) as closing_balance
    FROM all_combinations c
    LEFT JOIN monthly_closing mc ON c.customer_id = mc.customer_id AND c.month_year = mc.month_year
),
with_previous_balance AS (
    SELECT customer_id, month_year, closing_balance,
           LAG(closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_year) as prev_month_balance
    FROM with_closing_balance
)
SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) as txn_count
FROM customer_transactions
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING COUNT(*) = 0

WITH purchase_events AS (
    SELECT se.cookie_id, se.visit_id, se.sequence_number, se.event_time
    FROM shopping_cart_events se
    WHERE se.event_type = 3
),
product_events AS (
    SELECT se.cookie_id, se.visit_id, se.page_id, se.event_type, se.sequence_number, se.event_time, sph.product_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events se
    LEFT JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy sph ON se.page_id = sph.page_id
    WHERE se.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
    AND sph.product_id IS NOT NULL
),
purchase_with_product AS (
    SELECT pe2.cookie_id, pe2.visit_id, pe2.product_id, pe2.event_time as product_event_time, pe2.sequence_number as product_seq
    FROM purchase_events pe
    JOIN product_events pe2 ON pe.cookie_id = pe2.cookie_id AND pe.visit_id = pe2.visit_id
    WHERE pe2.event_type IN (1, 2)
    AND pe2.event_time < pe.event_time
    AND pe2.product_id IS NOT NULL
    AND pe2.sequence_number = (
        SELECT MAX(pe3.sequence_number) 
        FROM product_events pe3 
        WHERE pe3.cookie_id = pe.cookie_id 
        AND pe3.visit_id = pe.visit_id 
        AND pe3.event_type IN (1, 2)
        AND pe3.event_time < pe.event_time
    )
),
purchase_counts AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) as purchases
    FROM purchase_with_product
    GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT ps.product_id,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN ps.event_type = 1 THEN 1 END) as views,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN ps.event_type = 2 THEN 1 END) as cart_additions,
       (COUNT(CASE WHEN ps.event_type = 2 THEN 1 END) - COALESCE(pc.purchases, 0)) as left_in_cart,
       COALESCE(pc.purchases, 0) as purchases
FROM product_events ps
LEFT JOIN purchase_counts pc ON ps.product_id = pc.product_id
GROUP BY ps.product_id, pc.purchases
ORDER BY ps.product_id

candidates.sql:
WITH purchases AS (
    SELECT visit_id, MIN(event_time) as purchase_time
    FROM shopping_cart_events
    WHERE event_type = 3
    GROUP BY visit_id
),
product_interactions AS (
    SELECT e.visit_id, e.page_id, e.event_type, e.event_time,
           h.product_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy h ON e.page_id = h.page_id
    WHERE h.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
),
last_interaction_before_purchase AS (
    SELECT pi.product_id, pi.visit_id, pi.event_type, pi.event_time,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pi.visit_id ORDER BY pi.event_time DESC) as rn
    FROM product_interactions pi
    JOIN purchases p ON pi.visit_id = p.visit_id
    WHERE pi.event_time < p.purchase_time
)
SELECT product_id, event_type, COUNT(*) as purchase_count
FROM last_interaction_before_purchase
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY product_id, event_type
ORDER BY product_id

candidates.sql:
SELECT 
    ph.product_id,
    ph.page_name,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS views,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS added_to_cart,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS actual_purchases,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS left_in_cart_without_purchase
FROM shopping_cart_events e
LEFT JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON e.page_id = ph.page_id
WHERE e.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
GROUP BY ph.product_id, ph.page_name
ORDER BY ph.product_id

candidates.sql:
WITH purchase_events AS (
    SELECT visit_id, cookie_id, page_id, event_type, sequence_number
    FROM shopping_cart_events 
    WHERE event_type = 3
),
add_to_cart_with_product AS (
    SELECT 
        sc.visit_id,
        sc.cookie_id,
        sc.page_id,
        sc.event_type,
        sc.sequence_number,
        ph.product_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events sc
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON sc.page_id = ph.page_id
    WHERE ph.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
    AND sc.event_type = 2
),
last_cart_before_purchase AS (
    SELECT 
        pe.visit_id,
        MAX(atcp.sequence_number) as max_cart_seq
    FROM purchase_events pe
    JOIN add_to_cart_with_product atcp ON pe.visit_id = atcp.visit_id AND atcp.sequence_number < pe.sequence_number
    GROUP BY pe.visit_id
),
purchased_products AS (
    SELECT 
        pe.visit_id,
        atcp.product_id
    FROM purchase_events pe
    JOIN add_to_cart_with_product atcp ON pe.visit_id = atcp.visit_id AND atcp.sequence_number < pe.sequence_number
    JOIN last_cart_before_purchase lbp ON pe.visit_id = lbp.visit_id
    AND atcp.sequence_number = lbp.max_cart_seq
),
page_views AS (
    SELECT 
        ph.product_id,
        COUNT(*) as page_views
    FROM shopping_cart_events sc
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON sc.page_id = ph.page_id
    WHERE ph.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
    AND sc.event_type = 1
    GROUP BY ph.product_id
),
add_to_cart AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        COUNT(*) as add_to_cart
    FROM add_to_cart_with_product
    GROUP BY product_id
),
purchases AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) as purchases
    FROM purchased_products
    GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT 
    pv.product_id,
    pv.page_views,
    atc.add_to_cart,
    pp.purchases,
    atc.add_to_cart - pp.purchases as left_in_cart
FROM page_views pv
JOIN add_to_cart atc ON pv.product_id = atc.product_id
JOIN purchases pp ON pv.product_id = pp.product_id
ORDER BY pv.product_id

local156.question: Analyze the annual average purchase price per Bitcoin by region, computed as the total dollar amount spent divided by the total quantity purchased each year, excluding the first year's data for each region. Then, for each year, rank the regions based on these average purchase prices, and calculate the annual percentage change in cost for each region compared to the previous year.

candidates.sql:
WITH yearly_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        SUBSTR(bt.txn_date, 7, 4) as txn_year,
        bm.region,
        SUM(bt.quantity * bp.price) as total_amount,
        SUM(bt.quantity) as total_quantity,
        SUM(bt.quantity * bp.price) / SUM(bt.quantity) as avg_price
    FROM bitcoin_transactions bt
    JOIN bitcoin_members bm ON bt.member_id = bm.member_id
    JOIN bitcoin_prices bp ON bt.txn_date = bp.market_date AND bt.ticker = bp.ticker
    WHERE bt.ticker = 'BTC' AND bt.txn_type = 'BUY'
    GROUP BY txn_year, bm.region
),
first_year AS (
    SELECT region, MIN(txn_year) as first_year
    FROM yearly_avg
    GROUP BY region
),
exclude_first AS (
    SELECT ta.*
    FROM yearly_avg ta
    JOIN first_year fy ON ta.region = fy.region
    WHERE ta.txn_year != fy.first_year
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        txn_year,
        region,
        avg_price,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_year ORDER BY avg_price DESC) as price_rank,
        LAG(avg_price) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY txn_year) as prev_year_price
    FROM exclude_first
)
SELECT 
    txn_year,
    region,
    ROUND(avg_price, 2) as avg_purchase_price,
    price_rank,
    ROUND(
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_year_price IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE (avg_price - prev_year_price) / prev_year_price * 100
        END, 2
    ) as yoy_pct_change
FROM ranked
ORDER BY txn_year, price_rank

WITH converted AS (
    SELECT 
        member_id,
        ticker,
        txn_date,
        txn_type,
        quantity,
        SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(txn_date, 4, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(txn_date, 7, 4) as converted_date
    FROM bitcoin_transactions 
    WHERE ticker = 'BTC' AND txn_type = 'BUY'
),
joined AS (
    SELECT 
        c.member_id,
        c.quantity,
        c.converted_date,
        m.region,
        p.price,
        CAST(SUBSTR(c.converted_date, 7, 4) AS INTEGER) as txn_year
    FROM converted c
    JOIN bitcoin_members m ON c.member_id = m.member_id
    JOIN bitcoin_prices p ON c.ticker = p.ticker AND c.converted_date = p.market_date
    WHERE m.region IS NOT NULL
),
agg AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        txn_year,
        SUM(price * quantity) / SUM(quantity) as avg_price
    FROM joined
    GROUP BY region, txn_year
),
with_first_year AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        txn_year,
        avg_price,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY txn_year) as rn
    FROM agg
),
excluded_first_year AS (
    SELECT region, txn_year, avg_price

),
with_rank AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        txn_year,
        avg_price,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_year ORDER BY avg_price DESC) as price_rank
    FROM excluded_first_year
),
with_pct_change AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        txn_year,
        avg_price,
        price_rank,
        LAG(avg_price) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY txn_year) as prev_year_price,
        CASE 
            WHEN LAG(avg_price) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY txn_year) IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE (avg_price - LAG(avg_price) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY txn_year)) / LAG(avg_price) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY txn_year) * 100
        END as pct_change
    FROM with_rank
),
final_result AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        txn_year,
        ROUND(avg_price, 2) as avg_price,
        price_rank,
        ROUND(pct_change, 2) as pct_change
    FROM with_pct_change
    ORDER BY txn_year, price_rank
)

candidates.sql:
WITH btc_transactions AS (
    SELECT 
        bt.member_id,
        bm.region,
        bt.ticker,
        bt.txn_date,
        bt.txn_type,
        bt.quantity,
        bp.price,
        CASE 
            WHEN bt.txn_date LIKE '%-2017' THEN '2017'
            WHEN bt.txn_date LIKE '%-2018' THEN '2018'
            WHEN bt.txn_date LIKE '%-2019' THEN '2019'
            WHEN bt.txn_date LIKE '%-2020' THEN '2020'
            WHEN bt.txn_date LIKE '%-2021' THEN '2021'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END as txn_year
    FROM bitcoin_transactions bt
    JOIN bitcoin_members bm ON bt.member_id = bm.member_id
    JOIN bitcoin_prices bp ON bt.txn_date = bp.market_date AND bt.ticker = bp.ticker
    WHERE bt.ticker = 'BTC' AND bt.txn_type = 'BUY'
),
yearly_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        txn_year,
        avg_price
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            region,
            txn_year,
            SUM(quantity * price) / SUM(quantity) as avg_price
        FROM btc_transactions
        GROUP BY region, txn_year
    ) sub
    WHERE NOT (region = 'Africa' AND txn_year = '2017')
    AND NOT (region = 'Asia' AND txn_year = '2017')
    AND NOT (region = 'Australia' AND txn_year = '2017')
    AND NOT (region = 'India' AND txn_year = '2017')
    AND NOT (region = 'United States' AND txn_year = '2017')
),
with_ranking AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        txn_year,
        avg_price,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_year ORDER BY avg_price DESC) as price_rank
    FROM yearly_agg
),
with_yoy AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        txn_year,
        avg_price,
        price_rank,
        LAG(avg_price) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY txn_year) as prev_year_price,
        CASE 
            WHEN LAG(avg_price) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY txn_year) IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE (avg_price - LAG(avg_price) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY txn_year)) / NULLIF(LAG(avg_price) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY txn_year), 0) * 100
        END as yoy_pct_change
    FROM with_ranking
)
SELECT 
    region,
    txn_year,
    ROUND(avg_price, 2) as avg_purchase_price,
    price_rank,
    ROUND(yoy_pct_change, 2) as yoy_pct_change
FROM with_yoy
ORDER BY txn_year, price_rank

local157.question: Using the "bitcoin_prices" table, please calculate the daily percentage change in trading volume for each ticker from August 1 to August 10, 2021, ensuring that any volume ending in "K" or "M" is accurately converted to thousands or millions, any "-" volume is treated as zero, only non-zero volumes are used to determine the previous day's volume, and the results are ordered by ticker and date.

candidates.sql:
WITH filtered_data AS (
    SELECT 
        ticker,
        market_date,
        volume,
        CASE 
            WHEN volume = '-' THEN 0
            WHEN volume LIKE '%M' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(volume, 1, LENGTH(volume)-1) AS DOUBLE) * 1000000
            WHEN volume LIKE '%K' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(volume, 1, LENGTH(volume)-1) AS DOUBLE) * 1000
            ELSE CAST(volume AS DOUBLE)
        END AS volume_numeric
    FROM bitcoin_prices
    WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(market_date, 7, 4) AS INT) = 2021 
      AND SUBSTR(market_date, 4, 2) = '08' 
      AND CAST(SUBSTR(market_date, 1, 2) AS INT) BETWEEN 1 AND 10
),
with_previous AS (
    SELECT 
        ticker,
        market_date,
        volume_numeric,
        LAG(volume_numeric) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY market_date) AS prev_volume
    FROM filtered_data
)
SELECT 
    ticker,
    market_date,
    CASE 
        WHEN prev_volume = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (volume_numeric - prev_volume) / prev_volume * 100
    END AS pct_change
FROM with_previous
WHERE prev_volume IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ticker, market_date

WITH volume_converted AS (
    SELECT 
        ticker,
        market_date,
        CASE 
            WHEN volume = '-' THEN 0
            WHEN volume LIKE '%M' THEN CAST(REPLACE(volume, 'M', '') AS DOUBLE) * 1000000
            WHEN volume LIKE '%K' THEN CAST(REPLACE(volume, 'K', '') AS DOUBLE) * 1000
            ELSE CAST(REPLACE(volume, ' ', '') AS DOUBLE) * 1000
        END AS volume_num
    FROM bitcoin_prices
    WHERE market_date IN ('01-08-2021', '02-08-2021', '03-08-2021', '04-08-2021', '05-08-2021', '06-08-2021', '07-08-2021', '08-08-2021', '09-08-2021', '10-08-2021')
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT 
        ticker,
        market_date,
        volume_num,
        LAG(volume_num) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY market_date) AS prev_volume
    FROM volume_converted
)
SELECT 
    ticker,
    market_date,
    ROUND((volume_num - prev_volume) * 100.0 / prev_volume, 2) AS pct_change
FROM with_prev
WHERE prev_volume IS NOT NULL AND prev_volume != 0
ORDER BY ticker, market_date

WITH volume_data AS (
  SELECT 
    ticker,
    market_date,
    volume,
    CASE 
      WHEN volume = '-' THEN 0
      WHEN volume LIKE '%M%' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(volume, 1, LENGTH(volume)-1) AS DOUBLE) * 1000000
      WHEN volume LIKE '%K%' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(volume, 1, LENGTH(volume)-1) AS DOUBLE) * 1000
      ELSE CAST(volume AS DOUBLE)
    END as volume_numeric
  FROM bitcoin_prices 
  WHERE (market_date LIKE '01-08-2021' OR market_date LIKE '02-08-2021' OR market_date LIKE '03-08-2021' OR market_date LIKE '04-08-2021' OR market_date LIKE '05-08-2021' OR market_date LIKE '06-08-2021' OR market_date LIKE '07-08-2021' OR market_date LIKE '08-08-2021' OR market_date LIKE '09-08-2021' OR market_date LIKE '10-08-2021')
),
with_prev_volume AS (
  SELECT 
    ticker,
    market_date,
    volume_numeric,
    LAG(volume_numeric) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY market_date) as prev_volume
  FROM volume_data
),
with_pct_change AS (
  SELECT 
    ticker,
    market_date,
    CASE

)

  market_date,

FROM with_pct_change
WHERE pct_change IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ticker, market_date

        MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as min_wholesale_price,

    WHERE year(CAST(w.whsle_date AS DATE)) IN (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023)

        vc.category_name,
        STRFTIME(CAST(vt.txn_date AS DATE), '%Y') as year,
        SUM(vt."qty_sold(kg)" * vt."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg") as total_selling_price
    FROM veg_txn_df vt
    JOIN veg_cat vc ON vt.item_code = vc.item_code
    WHERE STRFTIME(CAST(vt.txn_date AS DATE), '%Y') IN ('2020', '2021', '2022', '2023')
    GROUP BY vc.category_name, STRFTIME(CAST(vt.txn_date AS DATE), '%Y')
)
SELECT 
    wa.category_name,
    wa.year,
    ROUND(wa.avg_wholesale_price, 2) as avg_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(wa.max_wholesale_price, 2) as max_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(wa.min_wholesale_price, 2) as min_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(wa.max_wholesale_price - wa.min_wholesale_price, 2) as wholesale_price_difference,
    ROUND(wa.total_wholesale_price, 2) as total_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(sa.total_selling_price, 2) as total_selling_price,
    ROUND(wa.avg_loss_rate, 2) as avg_loss_rate,
    ROUND(wa.total_wholesale_price * wa.avg_loss_rate / 100, 2) as total_loss,
    ROUND(sa.total_selling_price - wa.total_wholesale_price, 2) as profit
FROM wholesale_agg wa
JOIN selling_agg sa ON wa.category_name = sa.category_name AND wa.year = sa.year
ORDER BY wa.year, wa.category_name

WITH wholesale_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        c.category_name,
        YEAR(CAST(w.whsle_date AS DATE)) as year,
        AVG(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as avg_wholesale_price,
        MAX(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as max_wholesale_price,
        MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as min_wholesale_price,
        MAX(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") - MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as wholesale_price_difference,
        SUM(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as total_wholesale_price
    FROM veg_whsle_df w
    JOIN veg_cat c ON w.item_code = c.item_code
    WHERE YEAR(CAST(w.whsle_date AS DATE)) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
    GROUP BY c.category_name, YEAR(CAST(w.whsle_date AS DATE))
),
selling_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        c.category_name,
        YEAR(CAST(t.txn_date AS DATE)) as year,
        SUM(t."qty_sold(kg)" * t."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg") as total_selling_price
    FROM veg_txn_df t
    JOIN veg_cat c ON t.item_code = c.item_code
    WHERE YEAR(CAST(t.txn_date AS DATE)) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
    GROUP BY c.category_name, YEAR(CAST(t.txn_date AS DATE))
),
loss_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        c.category_name,
        AVG(l."loss_rate_%") as avg_loss_rate
    FROM veg_cat c
    JOIN veg_loss_rate_df l ON c.item_code = l.item_code
    GROUP BY c.category_name
)
SELECT 
    w.category_name,
    w.year,
    ROUND(w.avg_wholesale_price, 2) as avg_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(w.max_wholesale_price, 2) as max_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(w.min_wholesale_price, 2) as min_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(w.wholesale_price_difference, 2) as wholesale_price_difference,
    ROUND(w.total_wholesale_price, 2) as total_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(s.total_selling_price, 2) as total_selling_price,
    ROUND(l.avg_loss_rate, 2) as avg_loss_rate,
    ROUND(s.total_selling_price * (l.avg_loss_rate / 100.0), 2) as total_loss,
    ROUND(s.total_selling_price - (s.total_selling_price * (l.avg_loss_rate / 100.0)), 2) as profit
FROM wholesale_metrics w
JOIN selling_metrics s ON w.category_name = s.category_name AND w.year = s.year
JOIN loss_metrics l ON w.category_name = l.category_name
ORDER BY w.category_name, w.year

WITH wholesale_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        c.category_name,
        TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(w.whsle_date, 1, 4) AS BIGINT) as year,
        AVG(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as avg_wholesale_price,
        MAX(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as max_wholesale_price,
        MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as min_wholesale_price,
        MAX(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") - MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as wholesale_price_diff,
        SUM(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as total_wholesale_price,
        AVG(l."loss_rate_%") as avg_loss_rate
    FROM veg_whsle_df w
    JOIN veg_cat c ON w.item_code = c.item_code
    LEFT JOIN veg_loss_rate_df l ON w.item_code = l.item_code
    WHERE TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(w.whsle_date, 1, 4) AS BIGINT) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
    GROUP BY c.category_name, TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(w.whsle_date, 1, 4) AS BIGINT)
),
selling_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        c.category_name,
        TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(t.txn_date, 1, 4) AS BIGINT) as year,
        SUM(t."qty_sold(kg)" * t."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg") as total_selling_price
    FROM veg_txn_df t
    JOIN veg_cat c ON t.item_code = c.item_code
    WHERE t."sale/return" = 'sale'
      AND TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(t.txn_date, 1, 4) AS BIGINT) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
    GROUP BY c.category_name, TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(t.txn_date, 1, 4) AS BIGINT)
),
avg_loss_by_category AS (
    SELECT 
        c.category_name,
        AVG(l."loss_rate_%") as avg_loss_rate
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df l
    JOIN veg_cat c ON l.item_code = c.item_code
    GROUP BY c.category_name
)
SELECT 
    wm.category_name,
    wm.year,
    ROUND(wm.avg_wholesale_price, 2) as avg_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(wm.max_wholesale_price, 2) as max_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(wm.min_wholesale_price, 2) as min_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(wm.wholesale_price_diff, 2) as wholesale_price_diff,
    ROUND(wm.total_wholesale_price, 2) as total_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(sm.total_selling_price, 2) as total_selling_price,
    ROUND(wm.avg_loss_rate, 2) as avg_loss_rate,
    ROUND(wm.total_wholesale_price * (wm.avg_loss_rate / 100.0), 2) as total_loss,
    ROUND(sm.total_selling_price - wm.total_wholesale_price - (wm.total_wholesale_price * (wm.avg_loss_rate / 100.0)), 2) as profit
FROM wholesale_metrics wm
JOIN selling_metrics sm ON wm.category_name = sm.category_name AND wm.year = sm.year
JOIN avg_loss_by_category alc ON wm.category_name = alc.category_name
ORDER BY wm.year, wm.category_name

local297.question: For each customer, group all deposits and withdrawals by the first day of each month to obtain a monthly net amount, then calculate each month’s closing balance by cumulatively summing these monthly nets. Next, determine the most recent month’s growth rate by comparing its closing balance to the prior month’s balance, treating deposits as positive and withdrawals as negative, and if the previous month’s balance is zero, the growth rate should be the current month’s balance multiplied by 100. Finally, compute the percentage of customers whose most recent month shows a growth rate of more than 5%.

candidates.sql:
WITH monthly_nets AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        substr(txn_date, 1, 7) || '-01' AS month_start,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
            WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS monthly_net
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
    GROUP BY customer_id, substr(txn_date, 1, 7) || '-01'
),
monthly_data AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month_start,
        monthly_net,
        SUM(monthly_net) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS closing_balance
    FROM monthly_nets
),
ranked_months AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month_start,
        closing_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start DESC) AS rn
    FROM monthly_data
),
growth_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        curr.customer_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev.closing_balance = 0 THEN curr.closing_balance * 100
            ELSE (1.0 * curr.closing_balance / prev.closing_balance) * 100
        END AS growth_rate
    FROM ranked_months curr
    JOIN ranked_months prev ON curr.customer_id = prev.customer_id AND curr.rn = 1 AND prev.rn = 2
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_customers,
    SUM(CASE WHEN growth_rate > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS customers_with_growth_gt_5,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN growth_rate > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage
FROM growth_rates

local298.question: For each month, calculate the total balance from all users for the previous month (measured as of the 1st of each month), replacing any negative balances with zero. Ensure that data from the first month is used only as a baseline for calculating previous total balance, and exclude it from the final output. Sort the results in ascending order by month.

candidates.sql:
WITH user_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        txn_type,
        txn_amount,
        CASE 
            WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
            WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount
            ELSE 0
        END AS balance_change
    FROM customer_transactions
),
user_running_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        SUM(balance_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS raw_running_balance
    FROM user_balances
),
user_running_balance_fixed AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        MAX(CASE WHEN raw_running_balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE raw_running_balance END) AS running_balance
    FROM user_running_balance
    GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
)
SELECT txn_date, SUM(running_balance) AS total_balance
FROM user_running_balance_fixed
WHERE txn_date IN ('2020-01-01', '2020-02-01', '2020-03-01', '2020-04-01')
GROUP BY txn_date
ORDER BY txn_date

WITH month_pairs AS (
    SELECT '2020-02' as output_month, '2020-01-31' as prev_month_end
    UNION ALL SELECT '2020-03', '2020-02-29'
    UNION ALL SELECT '2020-04', '2020-03-31'

balance_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        mp.output_month,
        mp.prev_month_end,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ct.txn_type = 'deposit' THEN ct.txn_amount 
                 WHEN ct.txn_type IN ('purchase', 'withdrawal') THEN -ct.txn_amount 
                 ELSE 0 END) as balance
    FROM month_pairs mp
    LEFT JOIN customer_transactions ct ON ct.txn_date <= mp.prev_month_end
    GROUP BY mp.output_month, mp.prev_month_end
)
SELECT output_month, 
       CASE WHEN balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE balance END as final_balance

WITH monthly_txn AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) as month,
        txn_date,
        CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
             WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
             ELSE 0 END as balance_change
    FROM customer_transactions
),
customer_month_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month,
        SUM(balance_change) as month_balance
    FROM monthly_txn
    GROUP BY customer_id, month
),
cumulative AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month,
        month_balance,
        SUM(month_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month
                                ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as end_of_month_balance
    FROM customer_month_balance
),
total_by_month AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        SUM(end_of_month_balance) as total_balance
    FROM cumulative
    GROUP BY month
),
with_next AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        total_balance,
        LEAD(month) OVER (ORDER BY month) as next_month
    FROM total_by_month
),
final_output AS (
    SELECT 
        next_month as output_month,
        CASE WHEN total_balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE total_balance END as total_balance
    FROM with_next
    WHERE next_month IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT * FROM final_output ORDER BY output_month

local299.question: For a bank database with customer transactions, calculate each customer's daily running balance (where deposits add to the balance and other transaction types subtract). For each customer and each day, compute the 30-day rolling average balance (only after having 30 days of data, and treating negative averages as zero). Then group these daily averages by month and find each customer's maximum 30-day average balance within each month. Sum these maximum values across all customers for each month. Consider the first month of each customer's transaction history as the baseline period and exclude it from the final results, presenting monthly totals of these summed maximum 30-day average balances.

candidates.sql:
WITH daily_transactions AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        txn_type,
        txn_amount,
        CASE 
            WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
            ELSE -txn_amount 
        END AS balance_change
    FROM customer_transactions
),
daily_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        SUM(balance_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date) AS day_num
    FROM daily_transactions
),
rolling_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        running_balance,
        GREATEST(0, AVG(running_balance) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id 
            ORDER BY txn_date 
            ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        )) AS rolling_avg_balance,
        day_num
    FROM daily_balance
),
with_month AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        rolling_avg_balance,
        day_num,
        CASE 
            WHEN txn_date LIKE '____-01-%' THEN 1
            WHEN txn_date LIKE '____-02-%' THEN 2
            WHEN txn_date LIKE '____-03-%' THEN 3
            WHEN txn_date LIKE '____-04-%' THEN 4
            WHEN txn_date LIKE '____-05-%' THEN 5
            WHEN txn_date LIKE '____-06-%' THEN 6
            WHEN txn_date LIKE '____-07-%' THEN 7
            WHEN txn_date LIKE '____-08-%' THEN 8
            WHEN txn_date LIKE '____-09-%' THEN 9
            WHEN txn_date LIKE '____-10-%' THEN 10
            WHEN txn_date LIKE '____-11-%' THEN 11
            WHEN txn_date LIKE '____-12-%' THEN 12
        END AS month_num,
        CASE 
            WHEN txn_date LIKE '____-01-%' THEN '01'
            WHEN txn_date LIKE '____-02-%' THEN '02'
            WHEN txn_date LIKE '____-03-%' THEN '03'
            WHEN txn_date LIKE '____-04-%' THEN '04'
            WHEN txn_date LIKE '____-05-%' THEN '05'
            WHEN txn_date LIKE '____-06-%' THEN '06'
            WHEN txn_date LIKE '____-07-%' THEN '07'
            WHEN txn_date LIKE '____-08-%' THEN '08'
            WHEN txn_date LIKE '____-09-%' THEN '09'
            WHEN txn_date LIKE '____-10-%' THEN '10'
            WHEN txn_date LIKE '____-11-%' THEN '11'
            WHEN txn_date LIKE '____-12-%' THEN '12'
        END AS month_str
    FROM rolling_avg
),
first_month AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(month_str) AS first_month_str
    FROM with_month
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT w.*
    FROM with_month w
    JOIN first_month fm ON w.customer_id = fm.customer_id
    WHERE w.day_num >= 30 AND w.month_str != fm.first_month_str
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM filtered

WITH daily_net AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        TRY_CAST(txn_date AS DATE) as txn_date,
        CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END as net_amount
    FROM customer_transactions
),
daily_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        SUM(net_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as running_balance,
        FIRST_VALUE(txn_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as first_txn_date
    FROM daily_net
    GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date, net_amount
),
rolling_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        running_balance,
        AVG(running_balance) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id 
            ORDER BY txn_date 
            ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) as rolling_avg_30day,
        first_txn_date,
        DATEDIFF('day', first_txn_date, txn_date) as days_since_first
    FROM daily_balance
),
with_month AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        rolling_avg_30day,
        first_txn_date,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM txn_date) as txn_month,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM txn_date) as txn_year,
        CASE WHEN rolling_avg_30day < 0 THEN 0 ELSE rolling_avg_30day END as avg_30day
    FROM rolling_avg
    WHERE days_since_first >= 30
),
customer_first_month AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TRY_CAST(first_txn_date AS DATE)) as first_month,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(first_txn_date AS DATE)) as first_year
    FROM (
        SELECT customer_id, TRY_CAST(FIRST_VALUE(txn_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date) AS DATE) as first_txn_date
        FROM customer_transactions
    )
),
customer_month_avg_max AS (
    SELECT 
        w.customer_id,
        w.txn_month,
        w.txn_year,
        MAX(w.avg_30day) as max_30day_avg
    FROM with_month w
    JOIN customer_first_month c ON w.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE (w.txn_month != c.first_month OR w.txn_year != c.first_year)
    GROUP BY w.customer_id, w.txn_month, w.txn_year
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) as unique_customers,
       COUNT(DISTINCT txn_month * 100 + txn_year) as unique_months
FROM customer_month_avg_max

),

        customer_id,
        txn_date,

        ) as running_balance
    FROM daily_transactions
),

    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        row_num,
        running_balance,
        AVG(running_balance) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id

        ) as avg_30_day_balance
    FROM running_balances
),
rolling_avg_30plus AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,

        SUM(max_30_day_avg) as total_max_balance

WITH RECURSIVE customer_dates AS (
    SELECT customer_id, CAST(MIN(txn_date) AS DATE) as first_date, CAST(MAX(txn_date) AS DATE) as last_date
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
date_series AS (
    SELECT customer_id, first_date, last_date, first_date as date
    FROM customer_dates
    UNION ALL
    SELECT customer_id, first_date, last_date, date + INTERVAL '1 day'
    FROM date_series
    WHERE date < last_date
),
txn_with_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        CAST(txn_date AS DATE) as txn_date,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id 
            ORDER BY txn_date
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS balance_on_txn_date
    FROM customer_transactions
),
daily_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        ds.customer_id,
        ds.date,
        tb.balance_on_txn_date as balance
    FROM date_series ds
    JOIN txn_with_balance tb 
        ON ds.customer_id = tb.customer_id 
        AND ds.date >= tb.txn_date
    ORDER BY ds.customer_id, ds.date, tb.txn_date
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT customer_id, date, MAX(balance) as balance
    FROM daily_balances
    GROUP BY customer_id, date
)

WITH RECURSIVE all_dates AS (
    SELECT '2020-01-01'::DATE as dt
    UNION ALL
    SELECT dt + INTERVAL '1' DAY FROM all_dates WHERE dt < '2020-04-28'::DATE
),
customer_ranges AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(txn_date) as min_date, MAX(txn_date) as max_date 
    FROM customer_transactions 
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_date_combos AS (
    SELECT 
        r.customer_id,
        r.min_date,
        r.max_date,
        a.dt
    FROM customer_ranges r
    CROSS JOIN all_dates a
    WHERE a.dt >= CAST(r.min_date AS DATE) AND a.dt <= CAST(r.max_date AS DATE)
),
transactions_with_sign AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date::DATE as txn_date_d,
        CASE 
            WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
            ELSE -txn_amount
        END as amount
    FROM customer_transactions
),
balances AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        c.dt,
        COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) as balance
    FROM customer_date_combos c
    LEFT JOIN transactions_with_sign t 
        ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id 
        AND t.txn_date_d <= c.dt
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.dt
),
balances_zeroed AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        dt,
        GREATEST(balance, 0) as balance
    FROM balances
)
SELECT customer_id, dt, balance
FROM balances_zeroed
WHERE customer_id = 1 AND dt >= '2020-03-01'::DATE AND dt <= '2020-03-31'::DATE
ORDER BY dt

WITH RECURSIVE customer_date_ranges AS (
    SELECT customer_id, TRY_CAST(MIN(txn_date) AS DATE) as min_date, TRY_CAST(MAX(txn_date) AS DATE) as max_date 
    FROM customer_transactions 
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
date_series AS (
    SELECT customer_id, min_date as curr_date 
    FROM customer_date_ranges
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ds.customer_id, ds.curr_date + INTERVAL '1 day' as curr_date
    FROM date_series ds
    JOIN customer_date_ranges dr ON ds.customer_id = dr.customer_id
    WHERE ds.curr_date < dr.max_date
),
transactions_with_date AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        TRY_CAST(txn_date AS DATE) as txn_date,
        txn_type,
        txn_amount
    FROM customer_transactions
),
daily_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        ds.customer_id,
        ds.curr_date as day_date,
        COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN t.txn_type = 'deposit' THEN t.txn_amount
                WHEN t.txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -t.txn_amount
                WHEN t.txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -t.txn_amount
                ELSE 0
            END
        ), 0) as balance_change
    FROM date_series ds
    LEFT JOIN transactions_with_date t ON ds.customer_id = t.customer_id AND ds.curr_date = t.txn_date
    GROUP BY ds.customer_id, ds.curr_date
),
daily_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        day_date,
        GREATEST(0, SUM(balance_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY day_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)) as daily_balance
    FROM daily_changes
),
monthly_max_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM day_date) as month,
        MAX(daily_balance) as max_daily_balance
    FROM daily_balances
    GROUP BY customer_id, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM day_date)
)
SELECT 
    month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) as num_customers,
    SUM(max_daily_balance) as total_max_balance
FROM monthly_max_balances
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

WITH RECURSIVE customer_ranges AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(txn_date) as min_date,
        MAX(txn_date) as max_date
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_date_ranges AS (
    SELECT 
        cr.customer_id,
        cr.min_date,
        cr.max_date,
        cr.min_date::DATE as date_val
    FROM customer_ranges cr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        cdr.customer_id,
        cr.min_date,
        cr.max_date,
        DATE_ADD(cdr.date_val, INTERVAL '1 day') as date_val
    FROM customer_date_ranges cdr, customer_ranges cr
    WHERE cdr.customer_id = cr.customer_id
      AND cdr.date_val < cr.max_date::DATE
),
cumulative_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        cdr.customer_id,
        cdr.date_val,
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN (t.txn_date)::DATE <= cdr.date_val THEN t.txn_amount
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) as balance
    FROM customer_date_ranges cdr
    LEFT JOIN customer_transactions t ON cdr.customer_id = t.customer_id
    GROUP BY cdr.customer_id, cdr.date_val
),
daily_balances_final AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        date_val,
        CASE WHEN balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE balance END as daily_balance
    FROM cumulative_balances
)
SELECT * FROM daily_balances_final WHERE customer_id = 1 ORDER BY date_val
